conditions.text: C1 — 1.3.2: in upadeśa a nasalised vowel is an इत्. The इत् of 1.1.71 (pratyāhāra formation) includes such a vowel: the र pratyāhāra is र् with the nasal अँ of लँण्.

quotes.quote: आदिरन्त्येनेत्संज्ञकेन सह गृह्यमाणस्तन्मध्यपतितानां वर्णानां ग्राहको भवति, स्वस्य च रूपस्य।

groups.group: carried / not a sūtra word | saṃjñā | X
groups.how_checked: Kāśikā 1.1.71; SK 1.3.2 and BM 1.1.71 on the र pratyāhāra.
groups.note: licensed 1 · not licensed 0 · unsure 0 — Licensed: इता means "with an इत्", and one of the its that form pratyāhāras is the 1.3.2 it (अँ of लँण्).

missed.why: Kāśikā on 1.3.2 names आदितश्च (7.2.16) as its pradeśa (आदित् = with an अँ it); no 1.3.2 credit. Same for इदितो नुम् धातोः (7.1.58) and उदितो वा (7.2.56) — every "X-इत्" word naming a vowel it.
इदितः = a dhātu with the it इँ.
